title: Custom import plugin settings are saved in import files with their default values.
body:
### Tested versions

4.7dev4

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (a6ed51df1) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7216) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads) - 63.78 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using a custom importer plugin that adds additional params, every single import file in the project will update with the default values added. This causes two problems:

1. Adding a new import plugin will touch every import file. This can create huge change sets in git.

2. Because the import file has been saved with a specific setting there is no way for the importer plugin to change the default setting value without requiring an update to every single import file (in my case, this is 1500 files)


### Steps to reproduce

Add an import plugin to a project which adds a new set of import parameters.

i.e.: I have one called "blender_zoo" which adds some default parameters. Those parameters get written out for every single `*.import` in the project.
```
_subresources={}
arp_skeleton=false
blender_zoo/import=false
blender_zoo/export_path="./exported"
blender_zoo/material_path="./plants/materials/plants.tres"
blender_zoo/debug=false
blender/nodes/visible=0
blender/nodes/active_collection_only=false
```

Expected behavior:

The import writer should not write out default parameters.

n/a
